`source01.json.gz` losslessly retains the original 207,993-byte source record,
including its trailing newline, all literal Decimal spellings, five operational
record/manifest pairs, the complete 475-member custody census and three native
input manifests. The census records its exact byte digest and original locator.
It was also checked byte for byte against the same selected operand in the
authenticated `battery-refined02` producing archive.

The test loader authenticates the compressed file and complete original bytes
before decoding the unchanged source version 1.0.0. It requires no session path,

This is exposed retained-history software evidence. The original diagnostic
entered once and returned no result; actual provider entries, completions and

qualification, physical units or numerical adequacy. It does not include or
recreate the large historical report or fabricate missing scientific results.
